# RABIES PRE-EXPOSURE PROPHYLAXIS

For patients exposed to a rabid animal, refer to the Rabies-Post Exposure Prophylaxis recommendations in the emergency department CDSS.
[Rabies Post-Exposure Prophylaxis](rabies-post-exposure-prophylaxis)

# Rabies Vaccination

People who are in high-risk groups should be vaccinated against rabies.
Rabies high risk groups
Rabies vaccine, 2 dose series

# Rabies Booster

People with continuous risk of rabies exposure should be tested for rabies virus neutralizing antibody every six months. Those with frequent risk of rabies exposure should be tested every two years.
Rabies risk categories
A booster vaccination should be administered if the serum titer falls to maintain a value of at least complete virus neutralization at a 1:5 serum dilution by the rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test.

Rabies virus rapid fluorescent focus inhibition test
Rabies booster vaccine
